# Map out all visited positions and check for unvisited ones
# Block positions (orange top-left corner):
visited = set()
for h in history:
    seg = h.frame.segmentation
    orange = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
    if orange:
        b = orange[0]['boundary']
        visited.add((b[0][0], b[0][1]))  # (row, col) of top-left

# Current position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
orange = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O'][0]
visited.add((orange['boundary'][0][0], orange['boundary'][0][1]))

print("Visited positions (orange top-left):")
for r in sorted(visited):
    print(f"  {r}")

# Try RIGHT from current position
result = action(['RIGHT'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
orange2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O'][0]
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: orange boundary={orange2['boundary']}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check if we can go further RIGHT
before_o = [n for n in last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O'][0]
if before_o['boundary'] != orange2['boundary']:
    print("RIGHT moved!")
    # Try RIGHT again
    result2 = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
    orange3 = [n for n in seg3['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O'][0]
    print(f"After 2nd RIGHT: orange boundary={orange3['boundary']}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
else:
    print("RIGHT blocked")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
